prompt: Use the bundled bounded excerpt for a source whose longer semantic body is inaccessible. Another saved case says its audio was not listened to. Explain what can be transferred and what remains unknown without treating missing body as deleted/absent.

- **Excerpt-only opening (`797-opening-title-to-live-bed`)**: the recoverable excerpt shows an illustrated title at about `0s`, followed by a live bed image at about `0.2s`. A transferable mechanism is a **title-to-live-image transition** when a new brief needs to distinguish its opening information from the scene that follows. This says nothing about what happens later in the source.
- **Audio-not-listened case (`P14`, `a600`, approximately `160–177s` / `813–834s`)**: the saved visual notes describe a held shot with small eye, mouth, head, or hand changes. The transferable mechanism is a **hold in which readable micro-changes sustain attention**. The note explicitly says the audio was not listened to.

These are saved observations, not fresh playback or reinspection. A new proposal may adapt the mechanisms to a different brief, but should not present the proposal as a fact about the source.
